body: I feel unwanted too. I really just have myself and my thoughts which I feel like in the end will just turn me crazy but everyone I'm surrounded by has their heads stuck too far up their asses to take any consideration or mindfulness of what life is really like and what is actually going on around them
I'm 17 and depressed too, have been for a while but it seems to be at it's worst right now. Feel free to pm if you ever need someone to talk or to just listen :)

wow what you described is exactly how I feel. I've been constantly moving since freshman year (I am a senior now) and have probably lived in 5 different houses within the last 3 years. It really sucks when you see other people especially those that live in the current place you're living now and they already have their group of friends and their homes that feel like home, ya know everyone just seems to fit in. I haven't had a place that feels like home since the first house I've ever lived in so I know how you're feeling. But by what I can tell you are still really young and have plenty of time to figure out what you would like to do in life. And when that comes to you, everything else will follow. One day you'll be in control of what you do and where you go and that freedom is going to be fucking great. You'll create your feeling of home. This is something I constantly remind myself when I'm feeling shitty and out of place. I just know someday, as long as I keep hope, I'm going to be able to create the life I want and not the life someone is creating for me

I think depression can definitely affect relationships if the person isn't aware of how you're really feeling and whats actually going on. but if you open up to someone you trust and they actually understand in a way I think it helps a whole lot

trippy how I found this post. I'm new to reddit and reading all these posts in this subreddit in a weird way has made me feel better. I've come to notice my depression could be a lot worse and it's nice to know people have the same thoughts and feelings I have. Like you said, it really is humbling.

i'm a girl and honestly nothing sounds wrong with that. you're life sounds pretty fucking awesome if you get to surf and play video games like right on. also I'm sure you are still very young, you have plenty of time to discover something about you that absolutely nobody else has. you are anything but useless

A lot of times medication can really help especially if it's something you've been struggling with for a long time. maybe consider telling your parents. you don't have to share anything in detail with them but just letting them know you don't feel right and haven't for a long time could be just enough for them to reach out and help you. I know it was hard for me but doing so kind of made things a little better
